description.zh: 优化首页与文章界面的视觉层级，改进液态导航、聊天滚动和文章详情体验。
description.en: Refines the home and article visual hierarchy, liquid navigation, chat scrolling and article details.

zh.title: 新增
items: 文章详情页下滑后显示液态玻璃标题胶囊
建立统一的 Starlore 语义配色与冷白视觉基调

zh.title: 优化
items: 重构首页 AI 主卡、快捷入口和内容层级
修复底部液态导航切换时放大停顿的问题
修复 AI 流式回复期间列表抢占用户滑动的问题
提高首页、文章列表和个人页卡片的清晰度与对比度
精简外观设置并移除自定义主题色配置

en.title: New
items: Liquid-glass title capsule appears after scrolling article details
Unified Starlore semantic colors and a cleaner cool-white visual foundation

en.title: Improved
items: Refined the home AI hero, quick actions and content hierarchy
Removed the pause in liquid bottom-navigation transitions
Prevented streaming AI replies from fighting manual chat scrolling
Improved card clarity and contrast across home, articles and profile
Simplified appearance settings and removed custom theme colors
